children: Industrial production in Malaysia increased by 4.7% year-on-year in July 2026, easing from a 6.5% rise in the previous month and below market forecasts of 5.4%.

It was the softest increase in industrial production since March, due mainly to softer rises in manufacturing (6.4% vs 7.3%), driven by lower production of transport equipment and other manufactures (4.5% vs 9.4%) and electrical and electronics products (13.3% vs 13.6%).
Meanwhile, electricity output also eased to 5.0% from 6.7%.
On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, industrial output edged down 0.1% in July, following a 0.5% fall in the preceding period.

title: Malaysia Industrial Output Growth at 4-Month Low
